title: Compatible exact structures on a fixed direct-image family
statement:
Fix universes u and w, a prime natural number l, and an algebraic closure Ω : Type w of ℚ_[l], with its given field and algebra structures. Let X and Y be schemes in universe u, each Noetherian and of finite topological Krull dimension, with l invertible in every stalk. Write dT and iT for the respective dimension and invertibility witnesses for each scheme T. All preservation hypotheses, functors, comparisons and conclusions are quantified exactly as follows.

theorem pbcDirectImageFamilyExact (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (pres : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualDerivedPush f (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj))
    (R : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out))
    (hR : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω,
      R.Φ E = pbcDescentDirectImage l Ω f pres E)
    (bR : PbcDirectImageBetaSpec l Ω f pres R) :
    ∃ C : StageSystem.CoherentExactMorphism (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out), C.base = R

The fixed scalar systems and normalization predicates are those of [def-weil-pbc-descent-interfaces], [def-per-rational-direct-image-family] and [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. The theorem adds exact structures to a supplied coherent family; it does not construct that family.

proof.text: Use the unique normalized exact shift at each actual rational direct-image stage and transport its exactness along hR. The scalar-comparison shift theorem supplies betaCommShift. Additivity is inherited from the explicit tensor-base-change transport. Package these structures with the unchanged R, so C.base = R is reflexivity.

split_report.summary: Separate exact structures on a fixed coherent normalized family from the explicit construction of its functors, beta maps and coefficient coherence. The construction and its BetaSpec are proved in the consumer.
split_report.blueprint: The final operations paragraph uses rational exact transport and shift compatibility. Whole-blueprint searches for direct-image family and shift equations return no equivalent blueprint statement.
split_report.edge_cases: Identity morphisms, empty schemes, repeated coefficient fields, independently sized coefficient algebraic closures, and proof-irrelevant preservation witnesses keep the same statement.
